picks.headline: GPT-6.1 Sol Released on Amazon Bedrock for Enterprise Agents
picks.why: Enterprise users can now deploy GPT-6.1 Sol on Bedrock for advanced agentic coding, computer use, and complex reasoning tasks.
picks.title: Bring near-Astra intelligence to everyday work with GPT-6.1 Sol on Amazon Bedrock

picks.headline: Reinforcement Learning Cyber Attack Agents Achieve Zero-Shot Transfer
picks.why: Decoupling state alignment from action translation enables autonomous RL agents to execute cyber attacks across new environments without retraining.
picks.title: Crossing the Cyber Divide: Sim-to-Sim and Sim-to-Real Transfer for RL Agents

picks.headline: KaliBench Introduces Verifiable Rewards for 1,642 Cybersecurity Tools
picks.why: Provides a massive, runtime-free benchmark for training and evaluating LLM command-line execution across realistic offensive and defensive tooling.
picks.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards

picks.headline: Latent Frequency Masking Neutralizes Generative Image Watermarks
picks.why: Demonstrates a simple frequency-domain attack that reliably removes invisible AI watermarks without degrading image quality.
picks.title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking

picks.headline: NVIDIA Details Infrastructure Strategies to Boost AI Factory ROI
picks.why: Outlines full-stack co-design techniques that maximize megawatt token output and stretch GPU operational lifespans up to nine years.
picks.title: Productive, Durable, Fungible: How NVIDIA AI Factories Maximize Return on Investment

papers.headline: Self-Attention Networks Prove Universal Interpolation via Sequence Depth Alone
papers.why: Proves mathematically that fixed-weight self-attention networks can interpolate token sequences purely through layer depth without updating projection weights.
papers.title: Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks

papers.headline: Mechanistic Audit Uncovers Hidden Damage Caused by LLM Steering
papers.why: Demonstrates that steering interventions in tool-using LLMs often boost aggregate benchmark scores while silently corrupting baseline-correct outputs.
papers.title: When Does Correction Become Repair? Mechanistic Auditing of Internal Interventions in Tool-Using LLMs

papers.headline: LoRA-Norm Fixes Update Imbalances in LoRA Without Additional Training
papers.why: Applies data-free spectral rebalancing to post-training LoRA updates to prevent adaptation imbalance without adding inference overhead.
papers.title: Learn the Directions, Normalize the Gains: Post-Training Normalization for LoRA
